models.description: Entry point to the OPC UA interface of an AM machine. An instance of this type aggregates all information related to one AM machine.
models.name: AdditiveManufacturing

models.description: OPC UA IA (Industrial Automation) CalibrationTarget - the richest deployable IA type, exposing calibration target metadata (8 children: target identifier, certificate, traceability, calibration date, expiry, reference values, accuracy). IA is a foundation library; CalibrationTarget is the most data-rich standalone type.
models.name: CalibrationTarget
